newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LIBERO TRARES TO LEAVE 1860 MUNICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LIBERO TRARES TO LEAVE 1860 MUNICH.

text.p: 1860 Munich suffered a jolt on Friday in their build-up for Sunday's match with arch-rivals Bayern Munich with the news that libero Berhard Trares will leave the club at the end of the season.
Trares, a stalwart of the side who had been with 1860 since their days in the regional league, said he would be joining Werder Bremen.
The 31-year-old player has been with 1860 for six years. He decided to leave after the club rejected his request for a new three-year contract.
